scope: B-cell lymphoma diagnostic, prognostic, and predictive markers. Internal research substrate only.

biomarker_records.scoring: Hans decision tree partitions DLBCL into germinal-center B-cell (GCB) vs non-GCB.
biomarker_records.therapy_linkage: Prognostic in DLBCL; non-GCB/ABC historically worse outcome. Increasingly intersects targeted approaches (e.g., agents with differential activity by COO).
biomarker_records.companion_dx_basis: Hans et al. Blood 2004 (IHC surrogate for gene-expression COO)

biomarker_records.scoring: Presence/absence of rearrangement for each locus; dual MYC+BCL2 defines the double-hit category.
biomarker_records.therapy_linkage: MYC+BCL2 double-hit defines DLBCL/HGBL-MYC/BCL2 with adverse prognosis, influencing regimen intensity. MYC/BCL6-only no longer qualifies for the DH category.

biomarker_records.scoring: MYC >=40% and BCL2 >=50% by IHC = dual-expressor; distinct from rearrangement.
biomarker_records.therapy_linkage: Adverse prognostic phenotype; explicitly NOT the same as double-hit (which is genetic). Common point of diagnostic confusion the articles should clarify.

biomarker_records.scoring: Nuclear cyclin D1 positivity; FISH for the translocation.
biomarker_records.therapy_linkage: Defining for mantle cell lymphoma; separates MCL from CLL and other CD5+ small B-cell lymphomas, directing MCL-specific therapy.
Confirms mantle cell lymphoma in cyclin D1-negative cases; SOX11-negative leukemic non-nodal MCL is a more indolent variant.

biomarker_records.biomarker: BCL2 rearrangement / t(14;18) and BCL2 IHC in follicles
biomarker_records.scoring: BCL2 protein expression within neoplastic follicles; t(14;18) by FISH.
biomarker_records.therapy_linkage: Distinguishes neoplastic follicular lymphoma from reactive follicular hyperplasia (reactive germinal centers are BCL2-negative); diagnostic cornerstone.
Supports diagnosis of lymphoplasmacytic lymphoma/WM; predicts BTK-inhibitor sensitivity (modified by CXCR4 status). Also frequent in immune-privileged-site LBCL.

biomarker_records.scoring: Deletion and/or pathogenic mutation present vs absent.
biomarker_records.therapy_linkage: Adverse predictor across B-cell lymphomas; in CLL and MCL directs away from chemoimmunotherapy toward targeted agents (BTK/BCL2 inhibitors).

biomarker_records.scoring: Mutated vs unmutated relative to germline.
biomarker_records.therapy_linkage: Prognostic in CLL and informs therapy selection and durability of response.
Target of anti-CD20 therapy (rituximab and successors); loss of expression has therapeutic implications and can occur after treatment.
Target of CD19 CAR-T and CD19/CD3 bispecifics in relapsed/refractory aggressive B-cell lymphoma; antigen loss is a resistance mechanism.
Defines/supports several entities (immune deficiency/dysregulation-associated LBCL, EBV+ DLBCL); informs prognosis and reduction-of-immunosuppression strategy in PTLD-type disease.
Key prognostic grade in mantle cell lymphoma; near-100% supports Burkitt; aids separation of aggressive from indolent disease.

notes: The double-hit (genetic, FISH) vs dual-expressor (protein, IHC) distinction is the single most clarifying point for the aggressive-lymphoma articles. CD19/CD20 records connect to the Liquid/cellular-therapy themes. Verify therapy linkages at write time.
